label: Huawei EchoLife HG612 Openreach VDSL2 modem
description: BT Openreach VDSL2 (profile 17a, 100 Mbit/s) and ADSL2+ bridge modem with one RJ-11 line port and two 10/100 Ethernet LAN ports, LAN1 for the bridged PPPoE path to the router and LAN2 for management access to its web and telnet interfaces.
notes: AAISP support documentation: the HG612 has LAN1 (bridge to the router's WAN, PPPoE bridged) and LAN2 (management, default 192.168.1.1), both Fast Ethernet; stock firmware is locked, unlocked firmware exposes web UI + telnet ('xdslcmd'). Openreach FTTC lines are VDSL2 17a, so both LAN ports and the line are 100M - the line is not gigabit.
